The lady called me out and told me to put my phone away. i ignored her and kept messaging my friend. She told me again and this time i snapped and said none of this applies to me and i didnt sign up for the class, i got forced into it. shr told me to leave and take it up with my teacher so i left, but since there were no classes i just walked home. my parents are pissed and my friend said i was embarrassing. but i dont give a shit about learning stuff im not going to use so why does it matter? aita? also SHE was the one who said to leave so i was just doing what she said
